params.name: Model Chat Service
params.description: Provides chat completion using various language models, leveraging GPU dispatch for load balancing and resource management.

actions.name: qwen3:8b
actions.description: Performs chat completion using the qwen3:8b model via the GPU dispatch service.

messages.description: An array of message objects with 'role' and 'content' fields, following the OpenAI chat completion format (e.g., [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Hello!'}]).

choices.description: An array of completion choices, each containing a 'message' object, in OpenAI format.
